species.name: Oak
species.description: Broad-crowned oak with sculpted branches, grouped foliage and softly veined early leaves.

species.name: Moonwillow
species.description: Curved trunk, cascading silver-green foliage and tiny crescent-shaped leaves

species.name: Bluebell
species.description: bowed stems carrying clusters of pale lavender bells

species.name: Starcap
species.description: broad, gently domed caps with small star shaped markings. Do not eat.

species.name: Lantern Birch
species.description: cream coloured bark with a few warm, lantern-like seed pods. A birch tree, but it lights up?

species.name: Berry Shrub
species.description: a compact, rounded bush with heart shaped leaves and dusky berries

species.name: Dew Fern
species.description: Broad, arching sage-green fronds unfurl from tightly curled shoots. Tiny beads of dew nestle along their tips, gathering wherever several Dewferns grow together

gardenEffects.name: Gathering Dew
gardenEffects.description: Plants gain 1.75% more water per Dew Fern, up to 7%.

species.name: Dawn Sorrel
species.description: A little carpet of heart-shaped leaves and ivory flowers traced with pale pink veins. Its folded leaves open like tiny fans when the woodland wakes.

species.name: Pearl Seal
species.description: Gracefully arching stems carry paired oval leaves above a row of creamy hanging bells. Each flower ends in a pale jade tip, like a pearl dipped in green.

species.name: Ember Rowan
species.description: A slender tree with featherlike leaves and clustered coral berries. Each berry carries a warm ember-coloured centre, bringing a little autumn warmth to the garden

species.name: Dusk Wand
species.description: Tall, gently bowed spires carry dusty rose bells with plum-speckled throats. The uppermost buds remain curled like little sleeping lanterns.

gardenEffects.name: Forest Chorus
gardenEffects.description: Garden attraction increases by 1% per distinct species, up to 9%.

species.name: Wisp Flower
species.description: Delicate ivory flowers float above a low skirt of divided leaves. Their softly curled petals seem to follow a breeze too gentle for the surrounding plants to feel.

species.name: Moon Bell
species.description: Pearl-white bells nod above the woodland floor. Beside a heartleaf, every passing footstep seems to wake another silver drop.

species.name: Heart Leaf
species.description: A low-growing woodland plant with soft, heart-shaped leaves. Morning dew gathers in their shallow folds, glimmering beneath nearby Moonbells.

species.name: Haven Bough
species.description: Its branches curl around the clearing like hands around a small flame. Beneath its shelter, the youngest shoots drink deeply and grow brave

gardenEffects.name: Nurse Canopy
gardenEffects.description: Sprouts and seedlings gain 11.5% more water.

species.name: Boughrunner
species.description: An eager vine with curling stems and honey-gold flowers. With every upward journey, it reaches for the next branch.

gardenEffects.name: Sweet Ascent

species.name: Swift Grass
species.description: Its slender blades rise in a sweeping crest, bright green with silvery edges. Dew gathers along their tips, scattering little flashes of light as each passing breeze sends a ripple through the tuft.

species.name: Iron Heart
species.description: Thick, blue-green leaves spread from a tightly furled center, overlapping like plates of armor.

species.name: Dew Jewel
species.description: A delicate woodland plant with translucent green stems, softly toothed leaves, and hanging orange flowers speckled with crimson. As its stored dew is released, the it's bright flowers shimmer in the morning sun

gardenEffects.name: First Drops
gardenEffects.description: The first 2,000 steps each day give 10% more step water.

species.name: Sun Spike
species.description: A compact tuft of arching, blue-green leaves supporting three flower spikes at uneven heights. Each spike resembles a rounded little torch, grading from buttery yellow at its base to warm orange at its tip.

Pale fiddleheads curl within its sheltered centre. Beneath the woodland canopy, each passing breeze lifts its layered fronds like softly moving lace

species.name: Honeycluster
species.description: Honey-gold mushrooms gather in a close, uneven cluster, their rounded caps sheltering smaller buttons below. Cream-coloured gills peek beneath the pale rims, while slender stems deepen to warm brown at their feet. Hidden beneath the woodland floor, fine fungal threads form quiet partnerships with nearby roots.
